delivery.replay: Request one bounded point-in-time replay; never replace a missing archive with fixture data.

requests.purpose: Credential-safe activation context; not part of the polling render path.

unavailable: A missing GameFrame renders unavailable or stale, never fixture data while connected.
A replay without retained observations is unavailable; the starter never fabricates a timeline.
Polling stops at a final phase and reports the last measured request count.
Credentials stay in the copied server bridge and never enter browser source or request URLs.

nextSteps: 0. Review lib/aura/rest-scoreboard-data.ts; its typed manifest is the editable request and field-selection seam.
1. Import styles/aura-rest-scoreboard.css once in your app shell.
2. Render fixtures/aura/rest-scoreboard.ts immediately without a key.
3. Set AURA_API_URL plus AURA_API_KEY, or AURA_API_URL plus RAPIDAPI_KEY and RAPIDAPI_HOST, in server-only environment variables.
4. Bind createAuraLiveScoreboardClient() and useAuraRestScoreboard() to one Aura game id for request-metered poll or replay data.
5. Run npx @aura-tl/cli doctor rest-scoreboard to verify fixture or paid-data activation without exposing the credential.
